-- DuckDB uses LEAST() not MIN() for two arguments
WITH inv_totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
),
order_picks AS (
    SELECT ol.id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.id) as rn,
           SUM(ol.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cum_order
    FROM orderlines ol
),
order_pick_amounts AS (
    SELECT op.id, op.product_id, op.order_qty,
           LEAST(op.cum_order, it.total_inv) - 
           LEAST(op.cum_order - op.order_qty, it.total_inv) as picked_qty
    FROM order_picks op
    JOIN inv_totals it ON op.product_id = it.product_id
)
SELECT * FROM order_pick_amounts ORDER BY product_id, id
